headline: Japan Post Holdings Sells $1.37 Million in Aflac Stock
summary: Japan Post Holdings executed a sale of $1.37 million worth of stock in American insurer Aflac.
why: Portfolio rebalancing and equity disposals by major financial conglomerates affect cross-border corporate holdings and institutional stakes.

impacts.name: Aflac Inc
impacts.why: Institutional stake reductions by major shareholders can introduce minor equity liquidity adjustments.
